title: Academic Success Predictor
summary: A student-dropout-risk prediction system built for a university AI course, using classification models trained on real and SDV-generated data. The sdv_generator.py module builds a Metadata object and fits an SDV GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to produce synthetic student records, and runs SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic to assess them, expanding the training set used by the classifiers.
